dedupe_keys.name: ferc form 556 certifications of qualifying facility status for generators over 1 mw purpa

description: The FERC Form 556 dataset on the regulator's data portal holds filings by owners of generating facilities certifying qualifying facility status under the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978. Contents: a facility with a maximum net power production capacity above 1 MW (1,000 kW) may obtain the status by self-certification or by applying for Commission certification, filing Form 556 electronically; the form collects the facility's power capacity, equipment, energy input and output, ownership, location and affiliated qualifying facilities. Producer: FERC, Office of Energy Market Regulation. Coverage: United States. Format and access: CSV and XLSX downloads from the dataset page and an API (dataset ID 35) that needs a free key; the row count and last-update date did not render from the cloud. Licence: only the portal's open data disclaimer (as is, no warranty). Caveats: a subset of official eForms filings without footnote data, and certification is voluntary so not every small generator is listed. Simulation uses: an inventory of small and cogeneration plants for distributed generation and capacity models. Related records: the FERC data portal record covers the other datasets.
